description: List contacts, optionally filtered by role (user or lead).

role.description: Optional role to filter contacts by (e.g. 'user' or 'lead').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list object with 'data' (contacts), 'type', and 'total_count'; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single contact by its id.

contact_id.description: The unique id of the contact.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the contact object; on failure (contact not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new contact with the given role and optional details.

role.description: The role of the contact (default 'user'). Typically 'user' or 'lead'.

email.description: Optional email address of the contact.

phone.description: Optional phone number of the contact.

company_id.description: Optional company id to associate the contact with.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created contact object; on failure, output contains an error message.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list object with 'data' (companies), 'type', and 'total_count'; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single company by its internal id or its company_id.

company_id.description: The internal id or the company_id of the company.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the company object; on failure (company not found), output contains an error message.

description: List conversations, optionally filtered by state (open or closed).

state.description: Optional state to filter conversations by (e.g. 'open' or 'closed').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a conversation.list object with 'conversations' and 'total_count'; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single conversation by its id, including its conversation parts.

conversation_id.description: The unique id of the conversation.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the conversation object with nested conversation_parts; on failure (conversation not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new conversation started by a contact with an initial message body.

contact_id.description: The id of the contact starting the conversation.

body.description: The body text of the initial message.

title.description: Optional conversation title; defaults to the first 60 chars of the body if omitted.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created conversation object with conversation_parts; on failure (contact not found), output contains an error message.

description: Add a reply (comment part) to an existing conversation.

conversation_id.description: The id of the conversation to reply to.

body.description: The body text of the reply.

author_type.description: The author type of the reply (default 'admin').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated conversation object with conversation_parts; on failure (conversation not found), output contains an error message.

description: Add an admin part to a conversation: a comment, note, assignment, close, or open action.

conversation_id.description: The id of the conversation to add the part to.

message_type.description: The part type: one of comment, note, assignment, close, or open.

body.description: Optional body text for the part.

author_id.description: The id of the admin author (default 'admin-jonas').

assignee_id.description: Optional assignee id, used when message_type is 'assignment' (defaults to author_id).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated conversation object with conversation_parts; on failure (conversation not found), output contains an error message.
